designAuthority.source: DESIGN.md plus the accepted Figma-derived 390 and 1440 Overview, Inventory catalog, loading, and item resources

change.overview: Authenticated, real-record projection organized into Needs attention, Ready, Blocked, What changed, and capability-filtered Continue work; no invented KPIs, predictions, or global totals.
change.inventoryMobile: Search-first 25-record server pages, compact state filters, On Hand/Reserved/Available cards, and a focus-trapped detail sheet with inert background and safe focus restoration.
change.inventoryDesktop: Dense table, persistent complementary inspector, keyboard search shortcut, recent ledger/reservation/asset context, and capability-filtered governed next steps.
change.truthBoundary: Server-derived balances are passed through unchanged; direct stock editing is absent; history and contextual actions remain read-only or route to existing authorized workflows.
change.dataFlow: Debounced query and filter changes cancel obsolete requests with AbortController; loading, filtered-empty, authorized-empty, denied, error, refresh, and stale-last-success states are explicit.
change.backend: Inventory now owns its filtered SQL page/count, skips the redundant generic Inventory read, limits all related collections to visible parents, and batches related D1 reads.

performance.measurementProfile: U04 and U05 canonical application builds produced with the same Vite application mode and installed dependency graph.
performance.bottleneck: The Inventory bootstrap returned the complete catalog plus broad global history/reference collections, while also issuing a redundant generic Inventory page read.

routeAssets.tradeoff: The bounded increase implements two production operational layouts, responsive card/table equivalence, inspector states, and accessible mobile modal behavior; total direct gzip remains the governing initial-transfer comparison.

inventoryProjectionProxy.scope: Pure page DTO projection/join in Node; not browser route-ready, Web Vitals, or network latency.

d1Effect.measurementClass: Deterministic application query-shape comparison plus real Miniflare schema-32 execution

sqlStatements.note: Batching reduces binding round trips; it does not mislabel batched SQL statements as removed work.

accessibility.mobileInspector: Modal dialog, initial focus, Tab containment, Escape close, inert background, scroll lock restoration, and trigger focus restoration.
accessibility.desktopInspector: Persistent complementary landmark with no modal backdrop or background lock.
accessibility.searchAndFilters: Visible search label, slash shortcut that ignores editable targets, fieldset/legend grouping, pressed-state buttons, and live result metadata.
accessibility.responsiveContract: Cards below 960 CSS pixels; dense table and persistent inspector from 960 CSS pixels; exact structural widths enumerate at 320, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440.

renderedBrowser.attempt: The frontend-390 U05 journey was launched after the preview became available, then stopped before rendering because the project-pinned Chromium executable is absent.
renderedBrowser.notClaimed: No fresh rendered five-width, keyboard, 200 percent reflow, focus-obscuration, visual-regression, Web Vitals, or route-ready PASS is claimed for U05.
fallbackEvidence: The exact Playwright configuration enumerates the real Overview-to-Inventory journey at 320, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels plus a 1440-to-720 CSS-pixel 200 percent reflow simulation.

Source and unit contracts cover abortable search, modal versus complementary semantics, focus containment, inert background, card/table equivalence, read-only balance truth, and bounded contextual histories.
The complete React application and staging variants compile through Vite and pass normal-asset, fixture-boundary, design, contrast, and hero-identity gates.
All 32 migrations and the changed Inventory SQL path execute in Miniflare D1 with real filtered totals and parent-bound histories.

rollback: Revert the isolated U05 commit. No migration, index, provider, deployment, or data rollback is required; the Inventory endpoint returns to the prior unbounded projection with the code rollback.
